seo.title: Landscaping FAQ: quotes, permits and scheduling | RNC
seo.description: Answers on free quotes, reply times, tree permits, CRD watering days, scheduling and our workmanship guarantee for properties across Greater Victoria.

lede: How quotes work, local rules, scheduling and what to expect.

faqs.q: How much does landscaping cost?
faqs.a: Every property is different, so we don't publish prices. We quote from a site visit or your photos and a written scope that lists the work, frequency and schedule. The quote is free. [Get a free quote](/free-quote/).

faqs.q: Is the quote really free?
faqs.a: Yes. There is no charge to request or receive a quote.

faqs.q: What affects the price of a quote?
faqs.a: Size of the area, access, the condition of the site, materials, disposal, how often we visit and the season. Your written quote states the assumptions.

faqs.q: How soon will I hear back?
faqs.a: We reply to every quote request within [REPLY TIME]. If it's urgent, call [PHONE].

faqs.q: Can you quote to our specification or tender?
faqs.a: Yes. Attach or describe it in the quote form and we'll quote to it. See [commercial](/commercial/).

faqs.q: What happens after I send a request?
faqs.a: We read it, arrange a site visit or ask for photos, and send a free written quote. See [how we work](/process/).

faqs.q: Why is there no email field on the quote form?
faqs.a: The form opens a new email in your own email app, so your address is already on the message. Nothing you type is stored by this website.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to cut down or prune a tree?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Each municipality has its own tree bylaw, and many protect Garry oak, arbutus and other native species at small sizes. We check before any work; your [area page](/areas/) links to the bylaw. See [tree permits and winter pruning](/resources/winter-pruning-and-storm-prep/). This is general information, not legal advice.

faqs.q: What are the CRD watering days?
faqs.a: Under Stage 1 (May 1 to September 30), even addresses water lawns Wednesday and Saturday, odd addresses Thursday and Sunday, 4 to 10 am or 7 to 10 pm. Drip and hand watering of gardens is allowed any day. Check the [CRD site](https://www.crd.ca/environment/water-conservation/watering-schedule) for current rules. Read our [watering guide](/resources/crd-watering-rules-guide/).

faqs.q: How do you dispose of invasive plants?
faqs.a: We keep them separate from green waste and dispose of them following CRD guidance.

faqs.q: How often should a lawn be mowed?
faqs.a: In spring growth, weekly or every other week is common. Summer and winter need less. Your plan sets the frequency.

faqs.q: Do you work in winter?
faqs.a: Yes. Pruning, cleanups, storm debris and some installation continue through Greater Victoria's mild winters.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: No, as long as we can reach the work area safely. Tell us about gates, pets and parking in your request.

faqs.q: What does grounds maintenance include?
faqs.a: Mowing, edging, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups, as listed in your scope. See [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/).

faqs.q: Does landscaping include irrigation?
faqs.a: It can. We install drip or spray zones during a build, or service an existing system. See [irrigation](/services/irrigation/).

faqs.q: Do you remove trees?
faqs.a: Yes, after checking whether a permit is needed. See [tree and vegetation management](/services/tree-vegetation/).

faqs.q: Which areas do you serve?
faqs.a: All 13 municipalities listed on our [areas page](/areas/), from Sidney to Sooke.

faqs.q: Are you insured and registered with WorkSafeBC?
faqs.a: Liability insurance: [LIABILITY LIMIT]. WorkSafeBC: [WORKSAFEBC STATUS]. Documents are available on request.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee your work?
faqs.a: Yes. Our workmanship guarantee covers [WARRANTY]. If something we installed or built does not hold up within that time because of how we did the work, tell us and we will put it right. See [how we work](/process/).

faqs.q: Are the projects and reviews on this site real?
faqs.a: Items marked Sample are examples of the work we do, not records of specific past jobs. We will replace them with real projects and reviews, shared with permission.
